not yet released Fixed in Apache Tomcat 10.1.63

Critical: Cluster TLS-PSK configured to use TLS 1.3 does not validate peer CVE-2026-133325

A key exchange without entity authentication vulnerability in allowed an unauthenticated node to join a cluster when the cluster was secured with TLS 1.3 and TLS-PSK.

Until Tomcat 10.1.63 is available, users are recommended to switch to TLS 1.2.

This was fixed with commit 8dcddccc.

This issue was reported to the Tomcat security team on 16 November 2026. The issue was made public on 19 November 2026.

Affects: 10.1.62

2026-11-16 Fixed in Apache Tomcat 10.1.62

Moderate: Multiple vulnerabilities in EncryptInterceptor CVE-2026-95517

Multiple vulnerabilities exist in the EncryptInterceptor including reliance on obfuscation or encryption of Security-Relevant inputs without integrity checking, improper validation of integrity check value and clear text transmission of sensitive information. These vulnerabilities have not been addressed. The EncryptInterceptor has been deprecated in favour of TLS encryption using TLS-PSK. All users of the EncryptInterceptor should switch to TLS encryption. Users should be mindful of CVE-2026-133325 and only use TLS 1.2 until Tomcat 10.1.63 is available.

This issue was reported to the Tomcat security team on 16 September 2026. The issue was made public on 4 September 2026.

Affects: 10.1.0-M1 to 10.1.61

Low: Incorrect security-role-ref with RequestDispatcher.forward() CVE-2026-106012

An incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache Tomcat could occur during a request dispatch if the request depended on a security-role-ref provided by the dispatch target.

This issue was reported to the Tomcat security team on 17 September 2026. The issue was made public on 19 November 2026.

Low: Jakarta Authentication secureResponse AuthException sends unprotected HTTP 200 response CVE-2026-116561

An improper cleanup on thrown exception vulnerability in Apache Tomcat meant that an HTTP 200 response was sent rather than an HTTP 500 response after a AuthException was thrown during Jakarta Authentication secureResponse().

This was fixed with commit 8d49ddc3.
